mechanism: Methimazole may cause agranulocytosis and bone marrow suppression, which could potentiate carbidopa-levodopa's known risk of hemolytic anemia and blood dyscrasias, plus potential additive CNS effects on movement disorders.
action: Monitor complete blood counts regularly; assess for signs of infection, unusual bruising, or worsening parkinsonian symptoms; consider alternative antithyroid agent if cytopenias develop.
